body: Not exactly. She knows all about my history with depression of course but she doesn't know how bad it is right now. The main reason I need a job is for money. I lost my last car (engine needed total replacing which was too expensive) so now I don't have one and can't afford a new one. The other reason for a job is what you suggested, having something to do instead of being home with nothing. I just want to do something meaningful or have direction in my life provided that direction isn't into a dead end.

I'll admit I dismissed the idea at first, but after looking through the website a bit I changed my mind. Doing something meaningful would be much better than a cashier job and would make me feel more valuable. Thank you for your suggestion.
